items.title: 13.6 Bond ki taqat ke lihaz se hydrogen halides ki nisbati thermal stability (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.6 with Table 13.5, printed pages 296-297.

blocks.text: Group mein fluorine se iodine tak neeche hydrogen halides ki thermal stability ghat-ti hai, kyunke H-X bond dissociation energies ghat-ti hain (Table 13.5): HF > HCl > HBr > HI. Hydrogen fluoride sab se zyada thermally mustahkam hai: fluorine ki oonchi electronegativity aur chhota radius orbitals ka mazboot overlap aur bohat mazboot H-F bond dete hain, sab se zyada bond dissociation energy, 569 kJ mol-1, ke saath. Hydrogen chloride HF se kam magar baqi se zyada mustahkam hai; chlorine ka bara radius H-Cl bond ko kamzor karta hai, 431 kJ mol-1. H-Br bond aur kamzor hai, 366 kJ mol-1, bromine ke bare radius aur kam orbital overlap ki wajah se. Hydrogen iodide sab se kam thermally mustahkam hai: bohat bara iodine atom hydrogen se kamzor overlap karta hai, sab se kamzor bond, 299 kJ mol-1, dete hue.

blocks.caption: H-X bonds ki bond dissociation energies (Table 13.5)
rows: sab se kam; halki garmi par toot-ti hai

blocks.prompt: Tables 13.4 aur 13.5 se andaza lagayein ke H2 + Cl2 ya H2 + Br2 mein kaun zyada exothermic hai, aur wazahat karein ke thermal stability bond dissociation energy se kaise juri hai (Quick Check 13.3c, d, e).
blocks.explanation: H2 + Cl2 zyada exothermic hai: yeh 431 kJ mol-1 ke do H-Cl bonds banata hai jabke 243 ka Cl-Cl bond torta hai, jabke H2 + Br2 sirf 366 kJ mol-1 ke do H-Br bonds banata aur 193 ka Br-Br bond torta hai; chlorine ke liye kul nikli energy zyada hai, us ke zyada musbat electrode potential ke mutabiq. H-X bond jitna mazboot, use torne ko utni zyada garmi chahiye, to thermal stability bond dissociation energy ke mutabiq hai; HF, chhoti, bohat electronegative fluorine ke sab se mazboot bond ke saath, sab se mustahkam hai.

items: Thermal stability HF > HCl > HBr > HI bond energy 569, 431, 366, 299 kJ mol-1 ke mutabiq: bare halogen atoms hydrogen se kam achha overlap karte hain, lambe, kamzor bonds dete hue.
